{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for SEVERE patients and exclude sentinel values (-999.0)
severe_patients_valid = data[(data['severity'] == 'severe') & (data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0)]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_patients_valid['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value among SEVERE patients (excluding sentinel values): {mean_biomarker_severe}')"}
